title: devexp-standup-2026-04-15
body:
Date: 2026-04-15
Attendees: Ava Chen (docs), Samir Patel (SDK), Marina Lopez (samples), Liam Morgan (quickstarts), Jun Park (rotation)
Absentees: N/A

Sprint context / goals this week:
- Finish new JS SDK streaming API docs + gallery sample. Target: public beta by next week. (PR #342)
- Publish consolidated quickstart for Hosted API + Dedicated with code snippets for Node + Python.
- Add two canonical samples (chat + embeddings reranking) to samples repo; add CI to smoke test them.

Updates / Notes:
- Ava (docs): Final pass on streaming docs done, addressing Samir's review comments. Need one more example showing function/tool-calling + streaming partial results. Draft pushed to Confluence: /display/DEVEXP/Streaming+Docs. Plan to merge docs branch after PR #342 is green.
- Samir (SDK): JS SDK PR (#342) is ready; added backpressure support for streaming and improved TypeScript typings. Found inconsistent behavior with chunked responses from hosted API (sometimes returns empty chunk header). Filed issue DEVEXP-130. Will add extra unit test.
- Marina (samples): Added chat sample v2 (uses streaming + tool calls), wiring to sample-runner. Two flaky e2e tests failing under GPU-backed CI; likely rate-limit / retry timing. Investigating.
- Liam (quickstarts): Consolidated quickstart draft for Hosted + Dedicated. Need one more Dedicated config example showing autoscale policy. Reached out to infra for sample YAML.
- Jun (rotation): UX checklist for docs site search improvements is half-done; planning to get design review next Tuesday.

Blockers:
- Waiting on infra for Dedicated autoscale example (ticket INFRA-482). Blocks publishing consolidated quickstart. Liam to follow up; if no response by EOD Wed, fallback to a simplified example and note "customer-specific config".
- Flaky CI for samples (Marina) — blocks merging sample PRs. Might be transient; Samir suggested adding retries in sample-runner and raising request to infra for increased CI concurrency for GPU runners in the short term.

Decisions / Agreements:
- Merge JS SDK PR (#342) after adding the extra streaming example and unit test for chunked responses. Goal: merge by Thu 2026-04-16.
- Publish quickstart as "Hosted + Dedicated (example)". Mark Dedicated section as example and link to infra ticket for advanced config.
- Add smoke test step to samples CI that uses a small hosted test API key (sanitized) to validate runtime behavior. Marina to add secret rotation doc.

Action items (owners):
- Ava: Add function-calling + streaming example to docs; update Confluence and link in PR description. (Due: 2026-04-16)
- Samir: Add unit test for chunked/empty-chunk responses; address DEVEXP-130; merge SDK PR after tests pass. (Due: 2026-04-16)
- Marina: Stabilize samples CI (add retries), push fix for flaky e2e, add secret rotation doc for sample-runner. (Due: 2026-04-20)
- Liam: Follow up with infra on INFRA-482; if no response, publish simplified Dedicated example and add TODO to iterate. (Due: 2026-04-17)
- Jun: Get design review for docs site search improvements and add to roadmap. (Due: 2026-04-22)

Notes / follow-ups:
- Related tickets: DEVEXP-128 (quickstart rewrite), DEVEXP-130 (chunked streaming bug), INFRA-482 (dedicated autoscale example).
- Remind PM (Priya) to coordinate customer-facing wording for Dedicated example (avoid promising autoscale SLOs).
- Next standup: 2026-04-22 10:00 PDT — agenda: post-merge retrospective for SDK streaming rollout, sample CI results, quickstart publish status.

Informal / scratchpad items (to capture for later):
- Consider adding a small "minimal-cost" sample that runs on CPU for quickstarts to reduce friction for new users.
- Evaluate adding a streaming debugger snippet that shows token-level latency breakdown in the JS SDK.

Links referenced: PR #342: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/342 | Quickstart ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/DEVEXP-128-update-quickstart | Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DEVEXP/Streaming+Docs

End of notes.
